messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Elevated error rate detected on inference-gateway (5xx surge) for region us-east-1. Triggered paging to oncall.
Jordan: I'm on it. I've started collecting request traces, will check the autoscaler and GPU pool health.
Alex: Noted. I'm pausing any non-essential deploys to the dedicated pool.
Maya: I see a correlation with a config rollout for batching heuristics ~09:12 UTC. Pushing logs now.
Jordan: Stack traces show nv_infer timeouts + queue backlog. Hypothesis: batching change increased tail latency under certain seq lengths.
Rita: Oncall handover in 30m — @Jordan can you summarize current mitigation for the next person?
Jordan: Sure — mitigation in place: 1) rollback batching flag (done) 2) scale +2 nodes to burst capacity (done) 3) enabled fallback model variant (smaller quantized) for tiered routing (in flight).
Sam: CS: a handful of customers in orgs A/B reported request failures; severity customer-reported. We need a concise status for them and a short damage assessment.
Lina: Product: capturing exact feature impact — embeddings and chat both affected; embeddings had higher failure rate. Collecting request counts per-route.
Jordan: Current numbers (approx): total affected requests ~1.2k over 18m window, error rate peaked at 8%, now <0.5% after rollback+scale.
Maya: Logs: relevant log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T09:13:24Z inference-gw ERROR batch_dispatch: timeout waiting for kernel (seq_len=2048) pool=dedicated-gpu-3
```
Jordan: Actions pending: - confirm rollback fully propagated (owner: Jordan, ETA: +10m) - confirm scaling restore to baseline and remove burst (owner: Maya, ETA: +40m) - prepare status page entry and customer note (owner: Sam, ETA: +20m)
Sam: Draft status blurb for customers (please review): "At 09:12 UTC we observed an elevated error rate impacting inference requests in us-east-1 due to a batching configuration change. We rolled back the change and scaled capacity; service is stable. A full retrospective will follow with timeline and corrective actions." Thoughts?
Rita: Good. Add a short apology and mention any retries we performed on their behalf (if any). Also include contact path (support@redwood.ai) and ETA for postmortem doc.
Alex: Suggest adding "no customer data was exposed" if that is verified. Security safe to confirm?
Jordan: Confirmed: no data leak indicators. Add line: "no customer data was exposed."
Maya: I pushed a small tweak to rate-limiter to smooth bursts; monitoring looks good.
Lina: Can we schedule a 45m retrospective tomorrow? I propose 09:00 UTC — invite: eng-runtime, eng-sre, cs, product. Owner: Lina to schedule.
Jordan: I'll write incident notes and timeline; will seed the doc with traces and the batching diff that caused it.
Sam: Customer comm plan: 1) Send short email to impacted accounts within 2 hours 2) Publish status page update (minor incident) 3) Share retrospective doc with customer contacts when ready.
Sam: Draft email to customers (for reviewers): "Hi — we experienced elevated failures for inference requests today at 09:12 UTC in us-east-1. We rolled back the change and restored service at 09:30 UTC. We're posting a short retrospective and corrective steps by EOD tomorrow. Apologies for the disruption — we appreciate your patience. — Redwood Support"
Rita: Minor edit: replace "EOD tomorrow" with a specific timestamp: "by 2026-03-15 17:00 UTC". Customers prefer dates.
Jordan: Postmortem scheduling: propose doc + async review; quick sync if needed. Owner for retro doc: Jordan. Draft due by 2026-03-15 12:00 UTC. Final to customers by 2026-03-15 17:00 UTC.
Maya: Remediation items I'm taking: 1) add a short-circuit in batching for seq_len >= 1024 to avoid pathological batching 2) add canary for batching config behind feature flag. ETA: 2026-03-18. Assign to Maya.
Alex: Ops actions: add autoscaler guardrails to prevent large concurrent scale-ins during config rollouts. I'll submit a PR with config template. ETA: 2026-03-20.
Sam: CS to send the approved email at 09:55 UTC. I'll coordinate with account owners for any proactive outreach.
Rita: Trust restoration steps: 1) Transparent timeline + traces in postmortem 2) Action items + owners + dates 3) Offer 1:1 office hours for impacted accounts (optional) — Sam to offer.
Sam: I'll compile impacted account list and reach out for interest in 1:1s.
Lina: Please add a monitoring alert to detect sudden increases in kernel timeouts (owner: Lina, ETA: 48h).
Jordan: Marking interim status: stable, mitigation validated, next steps: draft retro, customer comms, follow-up fixes. Will hand over oncall to @Rita in 30m.
Rita: Handoff acked. I'll keep watch and escalate if we see >1% error rate again.
Jordan: Thanks all. I'll post the incident doc link here when ready.
Sam: Posting status page copy for ops to paste:
```
Title: Elevated inference errors in us-east-1 (resolved)
Time: 09:12 UTC — 09:30 UTC
Impact: Intermittent failures for inference requests, primarily embeddings.
Mitigation: Rollback of batching config and temporary scale-up.
Next: Full retrospective and action plan by 2026-03-15 17:00 UTC.
```
Alex: LGTM :thumbsup:
Maya: :white_check_mark: monitoring dashboards show recovery.
Jordan: Incident doc (draft): https://docs.internal.redwood/incident/2065012345-draft — please comment.
Sam: I'll send customer messages after a final pass at 09:55 UTC and post status page update.
Rita: Closing note: assign follow-ups in tracker and ping me if anything slips. Good job on quick rollback and scaling. :tada:
Jordan: End of thread — will follow up with the retrospective link.
